layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.

Light: the sun is low in the south-west, at the bottom left of the image: faces turned to the left or to the viewer are lit, faces turned to the right are in shadow, snow is brightest on its left side, and nothing is lit from the right.

Class: one terrain map piece, a single free-standing cut-out rock mass in three-quarter view looking slightly down, calmer and less saturated than units, a thick dark outline on the outer silhouette, soft inner lines, big simple flat shapes with one shadow tone, no face. Nothing is drawn under or around it: no ground, grass, soil, slab or platform, only the transparent background.

Subject: a broad heavy mountain massif, one continuous mass of grey granite that fills the whole width of the image from the left edge to the right edge: two summits of different heights joined by a high rocky shoulder and a saddle, broad slopes stepping down in ledges and buttresses to a ragged foot of boulders along the bottom; the summits stay well below the top edge with empty space above them. Colours: lit rock warm light grey #a8a69c, shaded faces cool slate grey #5d5f6b, outline dark slate #4e4446, a small cap of cream snow #f2efe4 only on the highest summit. Wide, solid and lumpy like a big loaf of rock, not a group of separate pointed cones.
